card.name: Just before the word name
card.fires_on: Words that sit right before the word "name", such as common, trade, or family in naming phrases, and the word Name or names itself in labels. Also digits inside CAS registry numbers.

modes.label: Naming phrases
modes.description: Qualifier or label word in a phrase about names, where "name" is likely to come next.
modes.example: endosulfan’s<< trade>> name in Colombia) from the flower industry

modes.label: Table headers
modes.description: The word Name in a column heading such as drug class or name.
modes.example: Drug/Substance Class or<< Name>> Drug Interaction Effect Recommendations Aminogly

modes.label: CAS number digits
modes.description: Digits and hyphens inside a CAS registry number for an element, followed by text about its name.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting the word name (in English or Chinese) next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say or has just said a name, like common name or trade name.
